title: clearAllURL should be a function in connectCurrentRefinedValues
body:
clearAllURL is documented as a function but is actually a string. We will fix that in the doc so that we are consistent and do not break the current implementations (next minor). But for consistency with createUrl, it should be a function (next major).

Maybe we should update the name in this case, or think about changing the signature of the createURL function:

* `createURL() => url with everything cleared`
* `createURL(facet) => url with just facet cleared`
